The same evening, all your courses were gone; this was intentionally caused by another person, not by a system crash, timeout, administrative removal, enrollment competition, hacking, or account-credential theft (the host rejected every such route).

The definitive mechanism that the evidence supports is that the removal was deliberate and personal to that evening's food-related interaction, rather than a random system error; the takeaway is that you lost all your courses because of that person's intentional interference arising from the food-favor encounter you initiated, not because of a technical glitch or a missed deadline.

(Note: the evidence firmly establishes the who/when/motive shape and rules out all digital and administrative mechanisms, so the explanation centers on deliberate interference by the person connected to the food favor that evening.)
